description: Paid endpoint ($0.001): wallet-keyed delta versus this payer's last paid snapshot of Hyperliquid extreme funding. Returns watchlist APR changes and which coins entered, exited, or remain in the 10 most extreme funding rates (with APR and open-interest change). The first call for a wallet returns the current extremes with first_for_wallet=true. The snapshot is stored only after a successful settlement. Failed calls are never charged. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/funding-changes
name: get_funding_changes

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired (what this MCP tool returns, isError=true)

title: Funding changes since last paid call (paid, x402) — $0.001

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
